title: KAITO — If You Want Heat〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: MEIKO's coffee really is consistently incredible.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It would also explain why my whistling has a spring to its step today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Since I'm in such a good mood, I think I'll go for a long walk!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, quite a lot of time has passed since this plaza appeared...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (The little sprout's also grown into a little tree, so the place may yet transform even more in the future.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
There's certainly a chance...
Especially since...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They overwrote that legendary night by putting on an unbelievably amazing event!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They achieved the dream which was fundamental to this SEKAI's creation, so it's only natural to think that more changes are coming!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, I'll take this opportunity to walk around and see if I can make some new discoveries.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not seeing anything new here. Then, I'll try looking over there!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's see... The only place I'm yet to check is the alleyway with that wall blocking the way...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Huh..?
I'm hearing some fun-sounding music...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What if I listened more closely and...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wh-Who the...?!
Oh, Rin, Len, it's just you two.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, why do you sound so disappointed?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! We came over to see if you wanted to sing with us! MEIKO told us you were bored and just wandering around.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Really? I appreciate the thought, but I'm actually a little busy right now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Just take a close listen.
Do you hear that fun-sounding music?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, you're right! I can hear it!
It sounds really familiar for some reason!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think it's coming from over there...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Over there? The alley with the wall?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I know.
But let's go take a look.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It's really gone...
We have access to the other side now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Not only that, all the other walls also seem to have come crumbling down! How incredible is that?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, and we can hear the music that's been coming from the other side much more clearly now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You've made a remarkable discovery, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Despite just wandering around all the time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, was that last part really necessary?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But something like this seemed inevitable after RAD BLAST happened.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Despite losing to Taiga and their friends walking away, they kept their dream alive by not running from their problems.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe their sheer will was what caused this enormous wall to crumble.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Wait, we need to tell them about this!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're right! Let's go let them know right now!
